title: Vanillesque Variants
description: A resource pack (requiring etf) that adds a ton of variants to common mobs.
body:
REQUIRES ETF TO FUNCTION!

A resource pack that adds tons of variants for common mobs. New undead, monsters, animals, villagers, etc.

I don't know if I have plans to maintain this mod, but it does require update 26, as it uses the new baby models introduced in this version.
